linked_prs.title: [Hotfix] Fix bugs in AS studio
linked_prs.patch: diff --git a/src/agentscope/utils/logging_utils.py b/src/agentscope/utils/logging_utils.py index ac3d14927c..35cb6d957d 100644 --- a/src/agentscope/utils/logging_utils.py +++ b/src/agentscope/utils/logging_utils.py @@ -144,20 +144,26 @@ def log_studio(message: dict, uid: str, **kwargs: Any) -> None: msg = message["content"] flushing = True - if "url" in message: + if "url" in message and message["url"]: flushing = False + if isinstance(message["url"], str): + message["url"] = [message["url"]] for i in range(len(message["url"])): msg += "\n" + f"""""" - if "audio_path" in message: + if "audio_path" in message and message["audio_path"]: flushing = False + if isinstance(message["audio_path"], str): + message["audio_path"] = [message["audio_path"]] for i in range(len(message["audio_path"])): msg += ( "\n" + f"""""" ) - if "video_path" in message: + if "video_path" in message and message["video_path"]: flushing = False + if isinstance(message["video_path"], str): + message["video_path"] = [message["video_path"]] for i in range(len(message["video_path"])): msg += ( "\n" diff --git a/src/agentscope/web/studio/__init__.py b/src/agentscope/web/studio/__init__.py new file mode 100644 index 0000000000..e69de29bb2
